notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for the IEEE 1516.1-2025 no-time multi-region interaction routing boundary. The source uses only the official RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs plus the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, dimensional FOM, endpoint, and callback configuration. It creates two disjoint source regions and matching, combined, and disjoint subscriber regions, then verifies that a send carrying both source regions reaches each overlapping subscription exactly once, that a single-source send reaches only the corresponding overlap, that callback payload and source-region metadata are preserved, and that the disjoint subscription remains silent. No provider-specific names, registries, headers, or implementation behavior are required.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador regional interaction publication, region creation and commit, multi-region subscription, multi-region Send Interaction With Regions, cleanup, and FederateAmbassador receiveInteraction delivery
api_surfaces.source_symbol: IEEE 1516.1 RTIambassador multi-region interaction routing declarations
